resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR gives 2,329 ft (710 m), which matches our record; Tennessee Landforms gives 2,401 ft. We keep the NHLR figure.
NHLR calls the site Little War Gap Fire Tower and its description says War Fire Tower; Tennessee Landforms and the 2014 table use War. We treat these as one Hawkins County site.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers multiple property nomination

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR gives the 1947 build year; Tennessee Landforms and the 2014 table give no date. An East Tennessee Attractions listing seen only as a search snippet (its page returned navigation text only) gives 2,350 ft and 1947; not used. Owner names appear in the NHLR entry but are left out of the story for privacy. Access is inferred from the Private Owners entry; the Register does not describe a visit or an access arrangement. Confirm with the owners before any visit. Tower type beyond the watchman's cabin is not stated in the sources read. The do-not-climb and ask-the-owners advice in the story is the editor's recommendation; the Register says nothing on either.
